blocks.text: The query results list six individuals in the EMEA region who have a Python proficiency of 4 or higher and are hard-booked less than 60% between March and May 2026. Their names, hard-booked hours, and hard-booked percentages are provided. The hard-booked percentages are all well below 60%, ranging from 0% to 5%. This indicates these individuals have significant availability during this period. The data is complete for the specified criteria and time window, with no truncation or sampling noted.

blocks.title: List people in EMEA with Python skill proficiency >=4 and hard-booked less than 60% between March and May 2026, including person_id, name, hard_booked_hours and hard_booked_pct.

blocks.purpose: List people in EMEA with Python skill proficiency >=4 and hard-booked less than 60% between March and May 2026, including person_id, name, hard_booked_hours and hard_booked_pct.
blocks.sql:
WITH skill_python AS (
  SELECT ps.person_id
  FROM person_skills ps
  JOIN skills s ON ps.skill_id = s.skill_id
  WHERE s.name = 'Python' AND ps.proficiency >= 4
),
booked_hard AS (
  SELECT b.person_id,
         SUM(CAST(
           (CASE 
             WHEN b.start_ts < :window_start THEN :window_start ELSE b.start_ts END
           ) AS INTEGER)) AS start_clip,
         SUM(CAST(
           (CASE 
             WHEN b.end_ts > :window_end THEN :window_end ELSE b.end_ts END
           ) AS INTEGER)) AS end_clip,
         SUM(
           CASE
             WHEN b.start_ts < :window_start AND b.end_ts > :window_end THEN (:window_end - :window_start)
             WHEN b.start_ts < :window_start AND b.end_ts <= :window_end THEN (b.end_ts - :window_start)
             WHEN b.start_ts >= :window_start AND b.end_ts > :window_end THEN (:window_end - b.start_ts)
             ELSE (b.end_ts - b.start_ts)
           END
         ) AS intersecting_seconds,
         SUM(b.minutes) AS total_minutes
  FROM bookings b
  WHERE b.kind = 'hard'
    AND b.status_id IN (12,14) -- confirmed or closed bookings
    AND b.start_ts < :window_end
    AND b.end_ts > :window_start
  GROUP BY b.person_id
),
person_capacity AS (
  SELECT p.person_id, p.display_name
  FROM people p
  WHERE p.location_region = 'EMEA'
),
hard_booked_calc AS (
  SELECT pc.person_id, pc.display_name AS person_name,
         COALESCE(bh.total_minutes, 0) / 60.0 AS hard_booked_hours,
         CASE WHEN :capacity_hours > 0 THEN (COALESCE(bh.total_minutes, 0) / 60.0) / :capacity_hours * 100 ELSE NULL END AS hard_booked_pct
  FROM person_capacity pc
  LEFT JOIN booked_hard bh ON pc.person_id = bh.person_id
)
SELECT hbc.person_id, hbc.person_name AS name, hbc.hard_booked_hours, hbc.hard_booked_pct
FROM hard_booked_calc hbc
JOIN skill_python sp ON hbc.person_id = sp.person_id
WHERE hbc.hard_booked_pct < 60
ORDER BY hbc.person_name ASC;

assumptions: The date range March to May 2026 is inclusive, so start_date is 2026-03-01 and end_date is 2026-05-31.
Hard-booked percentage is calculated based on hard bookings (kind='hard') overlapping the date range for each person.
Proficiency 4 or higher means person_skills.proficiency >= 4 for the skill named 'Python'.
Region EMEA corresponds to people.location_region = 'EMEA'.
Less than 60% hard-booked means total hard booking allocation during the period is less than 60% of the total available time in that period.

blocks.title: List all open resource requirements belonging to engagements with a critical risk and no submitted request

blocks.purpose: List all open resource requirements belonging to engagements with a critical risk and no submitted request
blocks.sql:
WITH critical_engagements AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT engagement_id
    FROM risks
    WHERE severity = 'critical'
),
open_requirements AS (
    SELECT rr.requirement_id
    FROM requirement_requests rr
    WHERE rr.state = 'submitted'
),
open_resource_requirements AS (
    SELECT rr.*
    FROM resource_requirements rr
    JOIN status_lookup sl ON rr.status_id = sl.status_id
    WHERE sl.domain = 'requirement' AND sl.state_group = 'open'
)
SELECT orr.*
FROM open_resource_requirements orr
JOIN critical_engagements ce ON orr.engagement_id = ce.engagement_id
WHERE orr.requirement_id NOT IN (SELECT requirement_id FROM open_requirements)
ORDER BY orr.requirement_id ASC;

assumptions: Open resource requirements are those with status_id in the open state group for requirements.
Engagements with a critical risk have at least one risk record with severity='critical'.
Resource requirements with no submitted request have no associated requirement_requests in state='submitted'.
The reference date is 2026-04-01, but no explicit date filtering is requested, so all current open requirements are considered.

blocks.text: The total planned cost of active engagements in the Healthcare & Life Sciences (HLS) business unit, converted to the reporting currency (assumed to be USD), is approximately 5,157,842.10. This total is aggregated from all engagements with status 'ACT' (active) in the HLS business unit, using the planned cost in cents converted via the latest foreign exchange rates. There are 11 such active engagements included in this total. The calculation uses the primary currency and the maximum FX rate per currency to convert each engagement's planned cost before summing. This result is complete and based on all active engagements in HLS as defined.

blocks.title: Calculate total planned cost in reporting currency and count of active engagements in Healthcare & Life Sciences business unit

blocks.purpose: Calculate total planned cost in reporting currency and count of active engagements in Healthcare & Life Sciences business unit
blocks.sql:
WITH primary_currency AS (
    SELECT currency_id
    FROM currencies
    WHERE is_primary = 1
    LIMIT 1
), fx_rates AS (
    SELECT currency_id, MAX(fx_rate) AS fx_rate
    FROM rate_cards
    GROUP BY currency_id
), hls_bu AS (
    SELECT business_unit_id
    FROM business_units
    WHERE code = 'HLS'
), active_status AS (
    SELECT status_id
    FROM status_lookup
    WHERE domain = 'project' AND code = 'ACT'
)
SELECT
    CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CAST(e.planned_cost_cents AS REAL) * fr.fx_rate / 100.0), 0) AS REAL) AS total_usd,
    COUNT(DISTINCT e.engagement_id) AS engagement_count
FROM engagements e
JOIN hls_bu bu ON e.business_unit_id = bu.business_unit_id
JOIN active_status s ON e.status_id = s.status_id
JOIN primary_currency pc
JOIN fx_rates fr ON e.currency_id = fr.currency_id;

assumptions: Active engagements are those with status_lookup domain=project and code=ACT.
Planned cost is taken from engagements.planned_cost_cents and converted to reporting currency using the fx_rate from rate_cards.
The Healthcare & Life Sciences business unit corresponds to business_units.code = 'HLS'.
The total planned cost is aggregated over all active engagements in the HLS business unit.

blocks.title: Count of people in each region having the DSPy / LLM Ops skill at proficiency 3 or higher

blocks.purpose: Count of people in each region having the DSPy / LLM Ops skill at proficiency 3 or higher
blocks.sql:
WITH dspy_skill AS (
  SELECT skill_id FROM skills WHERE name = 'DSPy / LLM Ops'
)
SELECT
  p.location_region AS region,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ps.person_id) AS people
FROM
  people p
  JOIN person_skills ps ON p.person_id = ps.person_id
  JOIN dspy_skill ds ON ps.skill_id = ds.skill_id
WHERE
  ps.proficiency >= 3
GROUP BY
  p.location_region
ORDER BY
  p.location_region ASC;

assumptions: Proficiency 3 or higher means proficiency >= 3.
Regions correspond to people.location_region field with values AMER, APAC, EMEA, LATAM.

blocks.purpose: Count total number of blocked critical-path work items on active engagements
blocks.sql:
WITH active_engagements AS (
  SELECT engagement_id
  FROM engagements
  WHERE status_id = (SELECT status_id FROM status_lookup WHERE domain = 'project' AND code = 'ACT' LIMIT 1)
), blocked_critical_work_items AS (
  SELECT wi.work_item_id
  FROM work_items wi
  JOIN status_lookup sl ON wi.status_id = sl.status_id
  WHERE wi.is_critical = 1
    AND sl.domain = 'task' AND sl.code = 'BLK'
    AND wi.engagement_id IN (SELECT engagement_id FROM active_engagements)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_blocked_critical_items
FROM blocked_critical_work_items;

blocks.purpose: Top 5 active engagements ranked by number of blocked critical-path work items
blocks.sql:
WITH active_engagements AS (
  SELECT engagement_id, code
  FROM engagements
  WHERE status_id = (SELECT status_id FROM status_lookup WHERE domain = 'project' AND code = 'ACT' LIMIT 1)
), blocked_critical_work_items AS (
  SELECT wi.work_item_id, wi.engagement_id
  FROM work_items wi
  JOIN status_lookup sl ON wi.status_id = sl.status_id
  WHERE wi.is_critical = 1
    AND sl.domain = 'task' AND sl.code = 'BLK'
    AND wi.engagement_id IN (SELECT engagement_id FROM active_engagements)
)
SELECT ae.engagement_id, ae.code AS engagement_code, COUNT(bcwi.work_item_id) AS blocked_critical_items
FROM active_engagements ae
LEFT JOIN blocked_critical_work_items bcwi ON ae.engagement_id = bcwi.engagement_id
GROUP BY ae.engagement_id, ae.code
ORDER BY blocked_critical_items DESC, ae.engagement_id
LIMIT 5;

assumptions: Active engagements are those with status code 'ACT' in the project domain as of reference date 2026-04-01.
Blocked work items have status code 'BLK' in the task domain.
Critical-path work items are those with is_critical=1.

blocks.purpose: Count of people in APAC with Python skill proficiency 4 or higher
blocks.sql:
WITH python_skill AS (
  SELECT skill_id FROM skills WHERE name = 'Python'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.person_id) AS people
FROM people p
JOIN person_skills ps ON p.person_id = ps.person_id
JOIN python_skill sk ON ps.skill_id = sk.skill_id
WHERE p.location_region = 'APAC'
  AND ps.proficiency >= 4;

assumptions: Proficiency 4 or higher means proficiency >= 4.
APAC region is identified by people.location_region = 'APAC'.

blocks.purpose: Find people who have Python, Ruby on Rails, and PostgreSQL all at proficiency 5
blocks.sql:
WITH skill_ids AS (
  SELECT skill_id, name FROM skills WHERE name IN ('Python', 'Ruby on Rails', 'PostgreSQL')
), person_skill_counts AS (
  SELECT ps.person_id
  FROM person_skills ps
  JOIN skill_ids s ON ps.skill_id = s.skill_id
  WHERE ps.proficiency = 5
  GROUP BY ps.person_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ps.skill_id) = 3
)
SELECT p.person_id, p.display_name
FROM people p
JOIN person_skill_counts psc ON p.person_id = psc.person_id
ORDER BY p.display_name ASC;

blocks.purpose: Calculate total value in USD of vendor invoices issued in BRL currency
blocks.sql: WITH fx AS (SELECT currency_id, MAX(fx_rate) AS fx_rate FROM rate_cards GROUP BY currency_id) SELECT ROUND(SUM(bd.amount_cents * fx.fx_rate) / 100.0, 2) AS total_usd_value FROM billing_documents bd JOIN currencies c ON bd.currency_id = c.currency_id JOIN fx ON bd.currency_id = fx.currency_id WHERE c.iso_code = 'BRL';

blocks.purpose: Calculate total hard-booked hours for person ID 348 across all booking periods
blocks.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST(bookings.minutes AS REAL)) / 60.0, 0) AS hard_booked_hours
FROM bookings
WHERE bookings.person_id = :person_id
  AND bookings.kind = 'hard';
